title: AegisCPG Tool Attestation & Capability Record (TACR)
description: Author: Pratham Kapoor <prathamkapoor027@gmail.com>. The TACR is the single signed artefact produced by Stage 3 (Z3/TLA+ compositional verification plus OR-Tools MILP least-privilege synthesis) and consumed by Stage 4 (eBPF LSM policy compilation and the Rust Axum edit-automaton gateway). It is a DERIVED artefact: it can always be rebuilt from the source repository and the agent workflow graph, and it is never a system of record. Version fields are part of the canonicalised body so that a downgrade is itself detectable (TV6).

tacr_version.description: Schema version of this record. Downgrading this field is a detectable version rollback (TV6).

tool_id.description: Stable identifier of the attested tool, e.g. 'fs.read_file'.

server_id.description: Stable identifier of the hosting MCP/A2A server.

server_version.description: Semantic version of the server package that produced the attested DTG.

ast_dtg_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonicalised CompressedDtg: H(SHA256(JCS({server_id, language, nodes sorted by id, edges sorted by (source,target,transform_fn), sinks sorted by (file_path,line,sink_kind)}))). Binding both the syntactic schema and the compressed data-transformation graph is what makes a rug pull (TC2/TV5) a hash mismatch rather than a silent capability change.

syntactic_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the declared JSON Schema only. Retained so a consumer can attribute a divergence to the schema half or the DTG half of the Tool Integrity property.

semantic_divergence_score.description: Output of the GAT + GBDT two-branch classifier over the 3-hop DTG neighbourhood, in [0,1]. Scores at or above 0.50 make every capability in detected_sinks ineligible for a grant (hard constraint x_c = 0 in the MILP).

divergence_attributions.description: Per-branch explanation of the divergence score, so an operator can audit WHY a tool was scored. Emitted by ml-rag-engine/aegis_ml/gat_divergence.py.

capability_iou.description: Jaccard index between the declared capability set and the capability set the DTG actually reaches.

detected_sinks.description: Every OS-level sink the 3-hop DTG slice reaches, with file/line provenance. This is the ambient attack surface from which the MILP selects a minimum sufficient subset.

security_lattice_label.description: Denning security lattice level of the highest-classification data this tool can move. PUBLIC(0) is the bottom element. Every datum at or below this level may flow to a server whose clearance is at least as high; anything above requires an explicit FIDO2 declassification.

lattice_level.description: Numeric encoding of security_lattice_label: PUBLIC=0, INTERNAL=1, CONFIDENTIAL=2, SECRET=3. Denied when absent; the gateway derives it from the label.

granted_capabilities.description: The MILP-optimal least-privilege capability set. Every entry is consumed directly by crates/aegis-ebpf-loader/src/policy_compiler.rs to emit BPF map entries.

allowed_exec_sha256.description: MUST be empty whenever detected_sinks contains UnboundedDynamic: dynamic reflection makes static exec completeness undecidable, so AegisCPG fails closed (ADR-005). Asserted by invariant I4.

allowed_net_cidrs.description: MUST be empty whenever detected_sinks contains UnboundedDynamic. Same fail-closed rule as allowed_exec_sha256.

allow_dynamic_reflection.description: Operator-approved escape hatch for benign dynamic tooling. Never inferred; requires an explicit reviewed grant, and still leaves allowed_exec_sha256 empty.

composition_policy.description: Constraints on how this tool may participate in multi-tool sequences. denying a downstream tool does not prevent a chain of length three that skips the denied middle hop, so composition_policy is enforced over the DTG reachability relation and not over a naive adjacency list.

deny_downstream_tools.description: Server/tool pairs that may never receive this tool's output.

require_fido2_declassify_for_lattice_bel.description: DAGs at or below this lattice level may not receive this tool's output without a verified WebAuthn/FIDO2 P-256 assertion. SECRET (the bottom element) means: never, even under declassification.

max_chain_hops.description: Upper bound on compositional chain length considered by the verifier.

compression_stats.description: Raw CPG size versus compressed DTG size. Persisted so the ADR-002 compression claim is auditable per server rather than asserted globally.

verification.description: Record of the Stage 3 proof obligations discharged for this tool.

counterexample_trace.description: Constructive witness emitted when a property fails. Absence of this field means the corresponding property is discharged.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of this grant. Capability grants are explicitly expiring; an agent must re-attest rather than hold a standing ambient capability.

issued_at_unix.description: Issue timestamp, seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

ecdsa_p256_signature.description: Detached ECDSA P-256 signature over the JCS-canonicalised record with this field removed, encoded as 64 raw bytes (r||s) in unpadded base64url. Verification is public-key only, so a third party can validate a TACR with no shared secret (ADR-012).

signing_key_id.description: Thumbprint of the ES256 public key, SPKI SHA-256, base64url. Lets a consumer select the correct key from a transparency log.

allOf.$comment: ADR-005 fail-closed contract: dynamic reflection makes static exec/net completeness undecidable, so a tool whose DTG contains UnboundedDynamic can carry neither an exec allowlist nor a net CIDR list.
A tool that reaches CommandExec without an operator-reviewed exec allowlist has no enforceable exec grant. The capability set must not claim otherwise.
A converged graph carries no sink at all, so the lattice label must be PUBLIC and no OS capability may be granted.
